The Ultimate Fighting Championship® introduced the UFC's first-ever performance headphones today, including an Over-Ear Octagon™ and Special Edition In-Ear iSport Octagon™ headphones.( #MonsterUFC ) The Over-Ear Octagon™ headphones feature swiveling padded ear cups with an Octagon-cut pattern and a stylish red and black matte finish.
(photo: Noel Lee, the CEO of Monster on the Segway)

Another product, the 24K™ headphone, designed for users who are not afraid of expressing who they are through its brilliant look. Comfortable and ultra-durable, the swivel ear cup also adds function for the casual user or the DJ professional.
The show proceeded to dubstep-heavy video clips and a series of partnerships with brands including athletics company Adidas and the UFC.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
